report.summary:
Patient P-D001 (58, dual Medicaid/Medicare coverage with a transport benefit) screened negative for current utilities shutoff and transportation barriers on 2026-04-02, but has repeated dialysis no-shows (appt:2, appt:3, appt:5) and one upcoming nephrology visit (appt:6), so proactive transport and utility resources are warranted. Transit to DaVita Park Manor Dialysis for a 15:00 appointment is feasible: latest departure 13:25, arrival 14:48 (~84 min) via weekday CTA/Pace from home tract 17031260300 (27 transit stops within 800 m; 27.7% of households no vehicle).

Utilities: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays) and Neighborhood Energy Help. Lakeside Energy Assistance appears to be a scripted pharmacist-interaction flow, not a direct assistance line; I did not submit the patient's medication data to it.

Transport: Medicaid Ride Line — patient is a Medicaid plan member with a transport benefit; call the number on the card at least 2 business days before appointments. Paratransit Info Desk — ADA paratransit certification by phone, decisions up to 21 days. Senior Shuttle West (60+) — patient is 58, so not yet eligible.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides to medical appointments weekdays 7 AM–5 PM, but requires age 60+; patient is 58 so not yet eligible.
